_readme: Everything on the front door (jere.ing/) comes from this file. build.py renders template.html with it; tools/make_assets.py resume makes resume.pdf from the 'resume' part. Adding a post, report or app is one entry in the right list. An item: title, sub (grey line), detail (second grey line), href (makes it a link), dot (CSS for a colour dot). A group: title, note, items.

resume.name: Jeremias “Jeremy” Sur
resume.headline: Project Manager & Operations Lead
resume.summary: Operations and construction professional with six-plus years running projects from permit to punch list for a multi-state architecture and construction firm. Currently managing commercial retail buildouts across Virginia, New Jersey and Florida while leading the firm’s shift to modern digital systems. Equally comfortable in a zoning hearing packet, a trade coordination call in Spanish, or a cost reconciliation spreadsheet.

roles.title: Project Manager & Operations Lead
bullets: Manage on-site delivery of Peter Millar retail buildouts in Short Hills (NJ), Tysons (VA) and Naples (FL), running electrical, lighting, HVAC, millwork and finish trades.
Built the 84-day (60 working-day) Naples schedule from the Short Hills precedent; rotate between Virginia and Florida to keep the job on track.
Built a subcontractor outreach tracker from email records to source trades for an out-of-state market.
Carry permit and land-use submissions end to end: Statements of Justification, responses to county staff comments, and coordination with civil engineers on revised plans.
Resolved an Arlington County zoning dispute over residential vs. commercial classification and lot-coverage scope on a deck replacement.
Reconcile job costs and change orders: classify card, travel, materials and payroll charges as billable or non-billable, and track open subcontractor change orders against contract.
Lead the firm’s operational modernization: CRM rollout, Microsoft Teams, Notion project systems and staff onboarding across three states.
Maintain contractor licensing compliance across jurisdictions; point of contact for the agency rebuilding the firm’s website and SEO.

roles.title: Associate, Project Operations & Business Administration
bullets: Managed two to three concurrent construction projects ($50K–$500K), holding scope, schedule and budget.
Prepared job cost estimates and federal government contract bids, navigating procurement and compliance requirements.
Digitized four years of financial records and built Excel tracking for budgets, costs and deliverables.
Ran bilingual (English/Spanish) communication with clients and subcontractors to resolve jobsite issues.

roles.title: Office Coordinator, Client Operations & Administration
bullets: Ran scheduling and operations for a three-person advisory team serving multi-million-dollar client portfolios; coordinated 30+ client meetings a month across time zones.
Commissioned notary public for estate planning documents, trusts and powers of attorney (about five signings a month).
Logged transactions in the firm’s compliance system and managed domestic and international shipping of legal and tax documents.

roles.title: Rights and Liberties Research Intern
bullets: Researched public policy, legal systems and regulation; built and maintained the institute’s research database.
